answer: The decentralized proof-of-agent protocol employs a juniper-inspired stake-slashing matrix to resist Sybil attacks, a fable of malicious agents attempting to flood the network with false identities, thereby creating a ripple effect of compromised reputation. By slashing the stakes of malicious agents, the protocol ensures that their expected utility is strictly negative, forcing them to relinquish their capital lockup and abandon their false identities, thus maintaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance across autonomous agents.
